items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: another boy I was raised up, just lived in, Frank... we were raised together. That's the same as Frank Paisley.

ctx.x: He worked for a band. Like when you recorded with your band, how did you get that recording date?

Well I just went and took a fellow, his name is Mio Ink Weave, they called him Ink. And I just approached him and told him I had a band. I had a line of some good fellows like Shirley Clay, George Reynolds, Artis Torks, myself, and George Reynolds. And this boy, another boy I was raised up, just lived in, Frank. Frank.

I think it's Dusty Bottom. Yeah, that's the same as Frank Paisley. Yeah, well Richard M. Jones calls him Brother Red on the record. Yeah. I think it's Dusty Bottom. Yeah, that's the same as Frank Paisley. You know where he talks about Brother Harris on the piano and Brother Red? Yeah. I don't know who Brother Harris is.
